snapshot.title: Software Engineering Team Lead
snapshot.descriptionText:
Your profile

We’re looking for a highly skilled Software Engineering Team Lead who is passionate about people, engineering excellence, and building modern software development culture. In this role, you’ll guide a team of talented engineers, contribute to architectural decisions, and partner closely with Product and Design to translate business needs into robust technical solutions.

This is a true leadership‑first role, ideal for someone who thrives on developing others, shaping engineering practices, and delivering impactful product features while maintaining enough hands‑on involvement to stay technically sharp.
You’ll have a significant influence on how we build software, how our teams collaborate, and how we evolve our technical landscape.

What You'll Do

 * Lead, mentor, and support a team of software engineers. Provide regular feedback, facilitate career growth, and foster a healthy, collaborative team culture
 * Plan and prioritize engineering work, balancing feature development and team capacity to meet product roadmap commitments.
 * Collaborate with Product, Design, and cross‑functional stakeholders to translate business requirements into clear technical solutions
 * Contribute to system architecture and design discussions, guiding the team toward scalable and maintainable implementations
 * Remain hands‑on with development to stay close to the codebase, support technical decisions, and unblock the team when needed
 * Improve engineering processes, remove obstacles, drive best practices, and ensure high‑quality delivery
 * Actively participate in hiring-defining requirements, interviewing candidates, and building a high‑performing engineering team.

What You'll Need

 * 7-8+ years in software engineering with at least 2+ years leading or managing software engineers
 * Experience in SaaS product companies and complex technical ecosystems
 * Strong focus on people: mentoring, coaching, supporting career growth
 * Naturally curious mindset; someone who seeks improvement, learns continuously, and embraces change
 * Familiarity with modern engineering practices
 * Solid communication skills, organizational awareness, and a proactive approach to solving problems

Bonus Points For

 * Knowledge of Oil & Gas domain

Working Location

 * Croatia (Zagreb) - Hybrid
 * Europe - Remote

Why You’ll Love Working with Us

 * Work in a fast-growing and interesting industry
 * Flexible work that best fits your needs and the role
 * Competitive compensation with some niceadditionalperks
 * Top-notch offices and equipment
 * Continuous improvement and learning opportunities to grow your career
 * Team activities, not the usual one just to look nice on social media but what our team choose and ask for
 * A great teamof engaged passionate and helpful people
